CHAPTER I Preliminary CHAPTER II Abolition of alienations and conferment of occupancy rights CHAPTER III COMPENSATION AND AWARD THEREOF CHAPTER IV Miscellaneous Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Act not to apply to certain kinds of alienations. Section 4. Abolition of alienation and rights and incidents in respect thereof Section 5. Liability of alienated lands to payment of land revenue. Section 6. Occupancy rights in respect of alienated lands held under community service inam. Section 7. Occupancy rights in respect of lands held under watan. Section 8. What persons to be occupants in Wanta or Giras. Section 9. Occupancy rights in respect of alienated land to which section 6, 7 or 8 does not apply. Section 10. Effect of failure to pay occupancy price. Section 11. All public roads, etc., situate in alienated land to vest in Government. Section 12. Rights to trees. Section 13. (Deleted). Section 14. Compensation in respect of alienation consisting of assignment of land revenue. Section 15. Compensation in respect of allowances in cash or kind. Section 16. Compensation in respect of property referred to in section 11. Section 17. Method of awarding compensation to alienee. Section 18. Method of awarding compensation for abolition, etc., of rights of other person in property. Section 19. Provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894, applicable to award. Section 20. Appeal against Collector’s award. Section 21. Procedure before Revenue Tribunal. Section 22. Limitation. Section 23. Court-fees. Section 24. Finality of award and decision of Revenue Tribunal. Section 25. Inquiries and proceedings to be judicial proceedings. Section 26. Amount of compensation to be payable in transferable bonds except in certain cases. Section 27. Alienees to deliver records to authorized officers. Section 28. Provisions of Bom. LXVII of 1948 to govern the relations of Landlord and tenants. Section 29. Rules. Section 30. Saving. Schedule 1.
